purpose: Identify candidate dated trail references for an independent Park City label and distractor audit.

sources.name: Utah Trails and Pathways (UGRC / WFRC)
observed_metadata: Polyline feature layer; schema includes Class, SurfaceType, DesignatedUses, OwnerSteward, DataSource, created_date, and last_edited_date.
UGRC describes the statewide layer as incomplete and says it includes trails and pathways plus important road connections.
Its published source history includes purchased base data and subsequent agency and regional updates; current feature-level lineage must be checked before using any segment.
sources.local_overlap_evidence: The existing Park City reference review found 55 UGRC features already represented in the source labels. Those overlapping features are not independent evaluation evidence.
sources.permission_status: Not verified for this model use; copyright attribution is UGRC, WFRC, but the reviewed pages do not establish a license for this derived use.
sources.why: Useful fields may help locate dated, stewarded trail segments, but existing overlap, incompleteness, mixed path/road-connection semantics, and unverified use terms prevent treating the layer as independent truth. Exclude all geometry already used by source labels and manually verify any non-overlap candidate against dated imagery or field evidence.

sources.name: Mountain Trails Foundation Park City Trail Guide and current trail reports
observed_metadata: The organization describes its work as building, maintaining, and protecting non-motorized trails in the Park City area.
Its public guide provides trail and area descriptions, maps, and a route builder; current trail reports provide current conditions and updates.
sources.dated_historical_geometry: Not established from the reviewed public pages.
sources.why: Potentially authoritative local stewardship context, but current maps/reports alone do not establish historical geometry, positional accuracy, lineage, or permission for ML reuse.

sources.name: Park City Municipal GIS
observed_metadata: The City GIS page says the department maintains spatial data and services and identifies gis@parkcity.gov as its contact.
sources.dated_historical_geometry: Not established from the reviewed public page; the city's 2018 imagery service is not trail geometry.
sources.why: Ask for dated trail centerlines/as-builts, maintenance or reroute history, positional accuracy, source lineage, and written reuse terms; do not infer permission from public map access.

audit_consequence: Keep trusted VAL reference count at zero and all training arms ineligible until non-overlapping, dated target and distractor evidence is independently verified and reuse rights are documented.
